name: Event Registry (NewsAPI.ai)
summary: Global news articles and the events they report, annotated with concepts, categories, places and sentiment, with aggregates and URI lookups.

api_key.description: An Event Registry / NewsAPI.ai key (eventregistry.org settings page). Sent as the apiKey query parameter.

notes: Every call spends tokens from the plan: a search of the last 30 days is cheap, and each older year searched costs more. Suggest lookups are the cheapest way to resolve a name into the URI the filters need.
Filters take URIs, not names: resolve a concept, category, source, author or place with the event-registry.suggest.* calls first.
Languages are ISO 639-3 codes (eng, deu, spa...), not two-letter codes. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD.
The text-analytics calls (annotation, categorisation, sentiment) and the minute streams are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Search news articles
endpoints.summary: Articles matching keywords, concepts, categories, sources, places, languages, dates and sentiment; or aggregates of them over time, source, concept or sentiment.

keyword.description: Keyword or phrase the articles mention; repeat for several (at most 60), all required unless keywordOper is or.

keywordLoc.description: Where keyword must appear: body (default), title, or both.

keywordOper.description: and (default): every keyword must appear; or: any one.

keywordSearchMode.description: phrase (default): each keyword as a phrase; simple: words in any order; exact: a Boolean/proximity expression.

conceptUri.description: Concept URI (from event-registry.suggest.concepts) the articles mention; at most 50, all required unless conceptOper is or.

conceptOper.description: and (default) or or, across conceptUri values.

categoryUri.description: Category URI (from event-registry.suggest.categories); at most 20, any matches unless categoryOper is and.

categoryOper.description: or (default) or and, across categoryUri values.

sourceUri.description: Source URI (from event-registry.suggest.sources), e.g. bbc.com; any of several matches.

sourceLocationUri.description: Only sources located at this place (location URI).

sourceGroupUri.description: Only sources in this predefined source group.

locationUri.description: Location URI (from event-registry.suggest.locations) of the dateline.

lang.description: ISO 639-3 language code(s), at most 5; all languages when left out.

ignoreKeyword.description: Drop events whose articles mention any of these keywords.

ignoreConceptUri.description: Drop events where any of these concepts is important.

ignoreSourceUri.description: Drop articles from any of these sources.

minSentiment.description: Lowest sentiment, -1 to 1; setting it keeps English articles only.

maxSentiment.description: Highest sentiment, -1 to 1; setting it keeps English articles only.

startSourceRankPercentile.description: Lowest source-rank percentile to keep, 0-90 in steps of 10 (default 0, the top sources).

endSourceRankPercentile.description: Highest source-rank percentile to keep, 10-100 in steps of 10 (default 100).

isDuplicateFilter.description: keepAll (default), skipDuplicates (drop copies of other articles) or keepOnlyDuplicates.

dataType.description: Content types to search: news (default), pr (press releases), blog.

query.description: A complex query as one JSON object in the Advanced Query Language ($query, $and, $or, $not...). When given, the separate filter parameters are ignored.

resultType.description: articles (default) for the list, or one aggregate: timeAggr, sourceAggr, conceptAggr, sentimentAggr...

articlesCount.description: Articles per page, up to 100 (the default).

articlesSortBy.description: date (default), rel (relevance), sourceImportance, sourceImportanceRank, sourceAlexaGlobalRank, sourceAlexaCountryRank, cosSim or none.

articlesSortByAsc.description: true for ascending order; descending by default.

articleBodyLen.description: Body characters to return; -1 (default) for the whole body.

includeArticleConcepts.description: true to add the concepts each article mentions.

includeArticleCategories.description: true to add each article's categories.

includeArticleSentiment.description: true to add each article's sentiment.

notes: Costs 1 token a call for the last 30 days, 5 per searched year for older articles; aggregates cost 5 (archive 10), concept trends 10 (archive 50).
Repeat a list parameter to give several values (keyword=a&keyword=b); arrays are sent that way.

endpoints.name: Get articles by URI
endpoints.summary: Full details of one or more articles: body, source, concepts, categories, duplicates.

articleUri.description: Article URI(s) from a search; repeat for several.

infoArticleBodyLen.description: Body characters to return, default 300; -1 for the whole body.

endpoints.name: Search news events
endpoints.summary: Events (clusters of articles about one happening) by keyword, concept, category, place, date, size and sentiment, or aggregates of them.

keyword.description: Keyword or phrase the event's articles mention; repeat for several, all required unless keywordOper is or.

keywordLoc.description: Where keyword must appear: body (default), title, or both.

keywordOper.description: and (default): every keyword must appear; or: any one.

conceptUri.description: Concept URI important to the event; at most 50, all required unless conceptOper is or.

conceptOper.description: and (default) or or, across conceptUri values.

sourceUri.description: Events with at least one article from this source.

locationUri.description: Location URI where the event happened.

lang.description: Events with articles in these languages (ISO 639-3).

dateStart.description: First event date, YYYY-MM-DD; the event date comes from the articles and can differ from publication dates.

reportingDateStart.description: First average reporting date of the event's articles, YYYY-MM-DD.

reportingDateEnd.description: Last average reporting date of the event's articles, YYYY-MM-DD.

minArticlesInEvent.description: Only events covered by at least this many articles.

maxArticlesInEvent.description: Only events covered by at most this many articles.

minSentiment.description: Lowest event sentiment, -1 to 1; keeps events covered in English only.

maxSentiment.description: Highest event sentiment, -1 to 1; keeps events covered in English only.

ignoreKeyword.description: Drop events whose articles mention any of these keywords.

ignoreConceptUri.description: Drop events where any of these concepts is important.

query.description: A complex query as one JSON object in the Advanced Query Language. When given, the separate filter parameters are ignored.

resultType.description: events (default) for the list, or one aggregate: timeAggr, locAggr, conceptAggr, sentimentAggr, breakingEvents...

eventsCount.description: Events per page, up to 50 (the default).

eventsSortBy.description: date (default), rel (relevance), size (article count) or none.

eventsSortByAsc.description: true for ascending order; descending by default.

eventImageCount.description: Images to include per event, default 0.

notes: Costs 5 tokens a call for the last 30 days, 20 per searched year for older events; aggregates cost 5 (archive 10) or 10 (archive 50) for the complex ones.

endpoints.name: Get an event
endpoints.summary: One event's summary, its articles, or an aggregate of them (keywords, sources, article trend, similar events).

resultType.description: info (default) for the summary, articles for its articles, or keywordAggr, sourceExAggr, articleTrend, similarEvents...

articlesLang.description: With resultType articles: only articles in these languages.

articlesIncludeDuplicates.description: With resultType articles: true to include copies of other articles.

lang.description: With resultType articles: only articles in these languages.

articleBodyLen.description: Body characters to return; -1 (default) for the whole body.

eventImageCount.description: Images to include per event, default 0.

endpoints.name: List breaking events
endpoints.summary: Events whose coverage is growing fastest right now.

breakingEventsCount.description: Events to return, at most 100 (the default).

breakingEventsMinBreakingScore.description: Lowest breaking score to keep, from 0 (default 0.2).

eventImageCount.description: Images to include per event, default 0.

endpoints.name: Find concept URIs
endpoints.summary: Concept URIs (people, organizations, places, things) whose label starts with or matches the text, most frequent first; also by ticker, ISIN, CIK or domain.

prefix.description: Name or start of a name to look up.

lang.description: What prefix is matched against: an ISO 639-3 language for labels, or ticker, isin, cik or domain.

endpoints.name: Find category URIs
endpoints.summary: Category URIs whose label matches the text.

prefix.description: Name or start of a name to look up.

endpoints.name: Find source URIs
endpoints.summary: News source URIs matching a source name or URL.

prefix.description: Name or start of a name to look up.

endpoints.name: Find author URIs
endpoints.summary: Author URIs matching an author's name.

prefix.description: Name or start of a name to look up.

endpoints.name: Find location URIs
endpoints.summary: Location URIs matching a place name.
